summary: Expanded the node around private-label/value-channel enablement with one mega-cap customer anchor and three underfollowed public suppliers or infrastructure assets. The strongest underfollowed angles are: retail EDI/compliance plumbing, private-label canned/frozen food capacity, and private-brand/contract snack-nut processing.
